# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

**ManpowerGroup Inc. - Amendment No. 2 to Credit Agreement**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** June 26, 2025

**Borrower/Company Overview:** ManpowerGroup Inc., a Wisconsin corporation

**Transaction Description:** Amendment No. 2 to an existing Credit Agreement originally dated May 27, 2022. The transaction involves ManpowerGroup Inc. as borrower, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent, and multiple lenders including BNP Paribas, Citibank N.A., ING Bank N.V. Dublin Branch, Société Générale, UniCredit Bank AG New York Branch, U.S. Bank National Association, BMO Bank N.A., Citizens Bank N.A., PNC Bank National Association, and Nordea Bank ABP New York Branch.

**Purpose of Financing:** N/A (Amendment does not specify the original purpose of the underlying credit facility)

**Company Background:** ManpowerGroup Inc. operates with consolidated subsidiaries and maintains receivables purchase agreements. The company reports quarterly and audited fiscal year financial statements. No additional company background information is provided in the amendment.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• **Strong banking relationships** - Facility backed by a diverse syndicate of reputable international and domestic banks
• **Established credit facility** - Amendment to existing 2022 credit agreement demonstrates ongoing lender support and relationship continuity
• **Financial flexibility enhancement** - Amendment increases cash netting thresholds in debt calculations (from $200M to $300M starting March 2026)
• **No defaults reported** - Borrower representations confirm no defaults or events of default are continuing
• **Compliance maintained** - All existing loan documents remain in full force and effect

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Limited visibility** - Amendment provides minimal information about underlying business operations, financial performance, or original deal terms
• **Covenant modifications** - Changes to "Consolidated Adjusted Debt" definition may indicate need for additional financial flexibility
• **Amendment fees required** - Lenders charging upfront fees suggests potential credit concerns or market conditions requiring compensation
